evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce UserArena, a real-world e-commerce interactive benchmark containing 64,729 session trajectories from 11,010 users, spanning 566,102 items and 13 action types.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: UserArena pairs these trajectories with an interactive environment and supports offline validation against outcomes from a controlled production A/B test, enabling five-level evaluation from output validity and local decisions to sequential behavior, personalization, and outcomes.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments show that OPTD achieves the strongest overall fidelity among the evaluated simulators under UserArena's evaluation protocol and most closely reproduces the production policy effect in offline simulation.
